printed_facts.fact: Nuclear energy consumption is 45% of global total
Hydroelectric energy consumption is 10% of global total
Fossil Fuels energy consumption is 30% of global total
Renewables energy consumption is 15% of global total

public_definitions: The goal is to identify the largest global energy consumption source category and route that source record to priority source monitoring.
The dashboard chart is the source for determining the largest category.
The routing options are: Route Nuclear, Route Hydroelectric, Keep Fossil Fuels on routine monitoring.
The routing criterion is 'Largest global energy consumption category'.
